In this special episode of Guest In The Newsroom, veteran actor Raza Murad takes us through some fascinating stories and lesser-known anecdotes from the golden era of Bollywood to the present day.
He opens up about the legendary rivalry between Rajesh Khanna and Amitabh Bachchan, the unprecedented stardom of Kaka, and how Bollywood changed during the transition from one superstar generation to another.
